detail.title: When Experts Disagree
detail.lede: It is tempting to think that with enough data, everyone should see the same truth. But experts often disagree. Why?
detail.reason: Updating our journal on the new focus on expert disagreement, explaining why this matters for our broader inquiry into how observers interact with reality.

detail.title: Expert Observer Disagreement
detail.question: How can two observers study the same phenomenon carefully and still reach different, yet reasoned, conclusions?
detail.reason: Notebook nb-expert-disagreement-001 resolves the core inquiry using available evidence.
